mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.cinema_id, c.cinema_name FROM screenings s JOIN cinemas c ON c.cinema_id = s.cinema_id WHERE s.movie_id = #{movieId} AND (s.screening_date, s.start_time) >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::time) ORDER BY c.cinema_id

SELECT s.screening_id, s.movie_id, s.cinema_id, c.cinema_name, s.room_id, r.room_name, r.floor, s.screening_date, s.start_time, s.end_time FROM screenings s JOIN rooms r ON r.room_id = s.room_id JOIN cinemas c ON c.cinema_id = s.cinema_id WHERE s.movie_id = #{movieId} AND s.cinema_id = #{cinemaId} AND (s.screening_date, s.start_time) >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::time) ORDER BY s.screening_date, s.start_time

SELECT s.screening_id, s.movie_id, s.cinema_id, c.cinema_name, s.room_id, r.room_name, r.floor, s.screening_date, s.start_time, s.end_time, m.title AS movie_title FROM screenings s JOIN rooms r ON r.room_id = s.room_id JOIN cinemas c ON c.cinema_id = s.cinema_id JOIN movies m ON m.movie_id = s.movie_id WHERE s.cinema_id = #{cinemaId} AND s.screening_date = #{date} ORDER BY s.start_time ASC, s.screening_id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM screenings s WHERE s.room_id = #{roomId} AND (s.screening_date + s.start_time) < ((CASE WHEN #{endTime} > #{startTime} THEN (CAST(#{date} AS date) + #{endTime}) ELSE ((CAST(#{date} AS date) + 1) + #{endTime}) END) + INTERVAL '60 minutes') AND ((CASE WHEN s.end_time > s.start_time THEN (s.screening_date + s.end_time) ELSE ((s.screening_date + 1) + s.end_time) END) + INTERVAL '60 minutes') > (CAST(#{date} AS date) + #{startTime})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO screenings (cinema_id, room_id, movie_id, screening_date, start_time, end_time) VALUES (#{cinemaId}, #{roomId}, #{movieId}, #{screeningDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime})
